title: XOR circuit construction
statement: For a natural number $n$ and pairs $p=(p_1,p_2)$ and $q=(q_1,q_2)$ of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, define a pair of circuit trees whose first component is $(p_1\land q_2)\lor(p_2\land q_1)$ and whose second component is $(p_1\land q_1)\lor(p_2\land q_2)$, with each conjunction and disjunction represented by the corresponding circuit node.
hypotheses_covered: pairs $p,q$ of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
